# Kailash Solar

> PM Surya Ghar Yojana & UPNEDA approved solar EPC in Meerut. Residential rooftop subsidies (up to ₹1,08,000) plus complete Commercial & Industrial EPC with Adani & Waaree panels — for homes, businesses, and institutions.

## About Us
Kailash Solar is a premium, end-to-end Solar EPC provider. Similar to top national brands, we offer hassle-free installations, zero-cost EMI financing assistance, and complete government subsidy handholding (PM Surya Ghar). We handle 3D site surveys, net-metering approvals, and provide 5-year AMC.
